title: Tilly Franklin – Endowment Model at Cambridge University (EP.363)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Tilly Franklin is the CEO and Chief Investment Officer at University of Cambridge Investment Management.
reader_summary.overview: Tilly Franklin is the CEO and Chief Investment Officer at University of Cambridge Investment Management, where she oversees the £4.0B Cambridge University Endowment Fund. UCIM applies an endowment model approach primarily investing in managers and with an overall emphasis on sustainability. We discuss Tilly's background that canvasses operating roles, direct private equity, at Apex, investing at Yale cub Alta Advisors.

key_points.text: We discuss Tilly's background that canvasses operating roles, direct private equity, at Apex, investing at Yale cub Alta Advisors.
We cover her work at UCIM across developing the team, portfolio, manager selection, and sustainability.
Lastly, we talk about Tilly's experience with GAIN, or Girls Are Investors, a non-profit organization that introduces women to careers in finance.
